Re-arrange the following phrases in the correct sequence to form a
meaningful sentence:
(A) is merely the practice of clearing
(B) one simple definition of mindfulness
(C) in order to manage stress and achieve health and happiness
(D) one’s mind of the daily distractions of life

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
The sentence begins with the nominal subject in (B) ('one simple definition of mindfulness'). The predicate follows in (A) ('is merely the practice of clearing'). The verb 'clearing' governs the prepositional phrase in (D) ('one's mind of the daily distractions of life'), followed by the teleological adverbial clause in (C) ('in order to manage stress and achieve health and happiness'). This yields (B)-(A)-(D)-(C).
Hence, option (C) is correct.
